companion_apps.name: Smart Shades
companion_apps.notes: Not required by the open direct-BLE clients. Travel-limit calibration is not reimplemented here.

identity.notes: Persist the selected generation and, for V2, the byte-1-selected model; never infer either later from a failed command.

manufacturer_data.description: Decode version first: <0x10 V2, >=0x10 V3. V2 name is exactly S; V3 generally has no name.

methods.notes: Mandatory generation selection is in protocol_details.generation_selection; never probe with writes.

manufacturer_data.description: Wazombi Labs. Byte 0 selects generation: below 0x10 is V2, at least 0x10 is V3. `S` is an exact V2 name, not a prefix to apply to V3.

identification.notes: A scanner must inspect the manufacturer payload before offering controls. Company ID alone does not select a command map; V3's control service is not a reliable advertisement filter.

device.name: SOMA Smart Shades 2 / Tilt 2 / Smart Shades 3
device.notes:
DANGER — SELECT THE GENERATION BEFORE ANY GATT WRITE. V2 and V3 are not interchangeable and there is no write-based probing fallback.
On V3, `51 00` is a type-length-framed GET_ZIGBEE_ENABLED request. On V2, writing a bare `0x51` to the legacy device service is reported by the V3 community integration to be a factory-reset operation whose recovery needs the vendor app. Never send V3 frames to V2, never send a bare opcode as a discovery probe, and never try one generation's command after the other fails.
V2 advertises local name `S` and manufacturer company ID 0x0370 with version below 0x10. V3 uses the same company ID, version at least 0x10 and normally no local name. V3 does not reliably advertise its control service; identify it from manufacturer data, not a service-UUID scan.
Positions are percent CLOSED: 0 = fully open, 100 = fully closed. Invert only at a UI that uses percent open. Tilt 2 uses 0 = closed upwards, 50 = open, 100 = closed downwards. V2 accepts one BLE central at a time according to the community client; close the vendor app or any bridge before connecting.
Exact S plus the version guard selects V2, not its model. A dedicated handler must then select Smart Shades 2 when V2Advertisement byte 1 bit 0x80 is clear and Tilt 2 when it is set. The generic BLE variant selector cannot evaluate that bit, so integration is identify_only and every V2 entity binding is withheld rather than exposing both Open endpoints. The V2 commands and decoder remain documented for that handler, including Tilt 2 open at position 50.

openness.notes: V2 and V3 are different protocols on different services. This spec deliberately covers only discovery, position, basic motor actions, identify and the narrowly documented battery surfaces. Calibration, schedules and OTA are excluded.

enter_pairing_mode.notes: No pairing-mode exchange is described by the open clients. ATT permissions still need verification on each unit.

exclusivity.notes: The one-central statement is community evidence for V2; do not generalize a bond limit to either generation.
exclusivity.recovery: For V2, close the vendor app and every other central/bridge before reconnecting. V3 connection limits are unverified.

pairing.notes: The absence of application-layer pairing in public sources is not proof that every firmware accepts unauthenticated writes. Check ATT permissions and bonding on the actual generation before implementing a client.

credentials.notes: No application-layer pairing key, Wi-Fi credential or cloud token is described by the public direct-BLE clients.
stored_on_device: Owner-configured name and physical travel limits; calibration writes are outside this spec
Possible link-layer bonding state, if any; ATT permissions and bond count are unverified

factory_reset.description: This warning exists to prevent accidental reset, not to authorize one. Calibration, Zigbee reset, V3 reset-settings and every other reset-like opcode are outside the safe control surface.
factory_reset.effect: A bare 0x51 on the V2 legacy device service is reported to factory-reset the shade and require vendor-app recovery. The complete cleared state and physical reset procedure are not established. No reset procedure is offered.

methods.description: Only after company 0x0370 yields version <0x10, exact V2 name S and byte-1 model selection. Uses one-byte characteristic values, never V3 type-length frames.
methods.name: V2 Smart Shades 2 / Tilt 2

steps.action: Confirm manufacturer company 0x0370, version below 0x10 and exact local name S, then select Smart Shades 2 when advertisement byte 1 bit 0x80 is clear or Tilt 2 when set; stop on any mismatch.
Close the vendor app and any bridge holding the V2 shade's single BLE connection.
Read current and target closed percentages before any movement; use only the selected model's V2 characteristic commands.
steps.expect: V2 position reads return 0-100 percent closed; no V3 frame or the other V2 model's Open command is emitted.

methods.description: Only after company 0x0370 yields version >=0x10. Uses the V3 command service even though it was not reliably advertised.
methods.name: V3 Smart Shades 3

steps.action: Confirm manufacturer company 0x0370 and version at least 0x10; do not require a local name or advertised control service.
Connect and discover the V3-only control service; refuse to continue if it is absent.
Write only type-length framed V3 requests, then read the response characteristic and verify its opcode and declared length.
steps.expect: A matching V3 response; a bare opcode or a response for another opcode is rejected.

setup.notes: No network provisioning or cloud account is needed for direct BLE. The shade must already have safe physical travel limits configured; this spec does not teach calibration. Setup confidence covers the public client flows, not an ATT-permission dump or a motor replay here. The V2 method is documentary while integration is identify_only and requires a dedicated variant handler.

rejoin.notes: There is no Wi-Fi network to rejoin. Preserve the generation and V2 model when moving to another controller.

steps.action: Disconnect the existing central or bridge; for V2 this is required before another central can connect.
Repeat passive generation selection and, for V2, byte-1 model selection in the dedicated handler, then use only the selected generation/model command map.
steps.expect: Once a dedicated handler exists, direct BLE control resumes without a factory reset, cloud account or ambiguous V2 Open endpoint.

testing.notes: No shade was discovered, connected, moved, reset or updated by this project. V2 and V3 facts come from the public community clients and protocol documents; their software vectors passed 14 V2 and 29 V3 tests, but those are not hardware tests. ATT permissions, pairing and physical calibration behavior remain open.

variants.notes: Manufacturer version below 0x10 and exact local name S; V2 characteristic-value protocol.
V2 with advertisement byte 1 bit 0x80; position 0 closed upwards, 50 open, 100 closed downwards.
Manufacturer version at least 0x10, normally no local name; V3 type-length command protocol.

entities.name: V3 Shade
entities.notes: Open and close use calibrated set-position frames. Poll v3_get_position and parse V3PositionReply after moves; percent closed.

entities.name: V3 Battery
entities.notes: Read passively from V3Advertisement or actively with v3_get_battery/V3BatteryReply.

V2Advertisement.description: Manufacturer payload after company ID; version <0x10. Byte 1 is not emitted as a trustworthy battery percentage.

fields.description: Tilt 2 flag only; all other bits, including any battery interpretation, remain unverified
fields.name: tilt

fields.description: ASCII name through byte 18: right-padded with spaces and ending in one ASCII 0 terminator before padding
fields.name: name_ascii

parse_rules: Require at least 4 bytes for position and 19 bytes for the fixed padded name field.
Strip trailing spaces, remove at most one final ASCII 0, then strip any padding before it. A name containing digits keeps those digits.
Never decode a battery percentage from byte 1; only bit 0x80 is used here.

V3Advertisement.description: Manufacturer payload after company ID; version >=0x10.
parse_rules: Require at least 3 bytes and validate both percentage ranges; trailing bytes are reserved.
Require opcode 0x0b and at least one data byte; reject a short frame or stale opcode.
Require opcode 0x0a and at least one data byte; reject a short frame or stale opcode.

dangerous_frame_difference.rule: Never write 0x51 or 51 00 to a V2 unit. Never use a bare V3 opcode without its length byte. Do not expose either reset or Zigbee operation as a discovery/readiness probe.
dangerous_frame_difference.v2: A bare 0x51 written to the legacy device service 00001890-b87f-490c-92cb-11ba5ea5167c is reported as factory reset.
dangerous_frame_difference.v3: 51 00 = GET_ZIGBEE_ENABLED request (documented here only to explain the collision; Zigbee control is out of scope).

excluded_surfaces: Travel-limit calibration, encoder positions, direction and reset-settings commands
Schedules, triggers, clock/timezone and solar automation
Firmware update, bootloader entry and the V2 firmware-control characteristic
Zigbee control/reset, SOMA Connect U1, original Tilt and Smart Shades 1
Battery percentage from V2 advertisement byte 1 or the standard 00002a19 characteristic

generation_selection.failure_policy: Missing/short payload or absent expected service means stop. Never probe the other protocol after a timeout or write failure.

rules.command_style: type | length | data on the V3-only service

v2_battery_estimate.formula: estimated_percent = clamp((battery_mv - 3600) * 100 // 500, 0, 100), using integer floor division before clamping
v2_battery_estimate.notes: Reported client conversion, not a direct percentage. Advertisement byte 1 and standard 00002a19 semantics are unresolved and not used.

v3_framing.response: Same framing, fetched with a plain read of 8998a466-a65f-4d49-90b2-927f41c55192 after write.
validation: Reject frames shorter than two bytes and payloads shorter than the declared length.
Require the response opcode to match the request so a stale previous reply is not accepted.
Ignore bytes beyond the declared payload only as forward-compatible extension data; never count them as the current field.

remaining_unknowns: ATT permissions and bonding must be captured separately on one V2 and one V3 unit before assuming unauthenticated writes.
V2 advertisement byte 1 beyond the Tilt bit and the standard 00002a19 characteristic are not trustworthy battery-percentage sources.
Exact V3 write-to-read timing and stale-response behavior across firmware need capture.
Travel-limit calibration, schedules, OTA, original Tilt and Smart Shades 1 are outside this spec.
The complete effect of the reported V2 bare-0x51 factory reset is unknown; it must never be used as a probe.

format.name: position_closed
format.notes: 0 open, 100 closed; Tilt semantics are in device.notes

characteristics.name: V2 Current Position
characteristics.notes: First byte is current closed percentage. Later bytes are schedule summaries and are intentionally not decoded.

tilt2_open.description: Tilt 2 open: set target position 50 (0x32), between closed-up 0 and closed-down 100.

v2_set_position.description: Set V2 target closed percentage, one byte 0-100.

v2_close.description: V2 fully down/closed (0x96); on Tilt 2 this is closed downwards at position 100.

v2_open.description: Smart Shades 2 fully up/open (0x69); not the Tilt 2 open action.

v2_stop_at_next_step.description: V2 stop at next step (0x01), distinct from immediate stop.

characteristics.name: V2 Battery Voltage
characteristics.notes: Reported V2 voltage in raw units of 10 mV. This is not the uncertain advertisement byte 1 or the standard 0x2a19 characteristic.

services.name: SOMA V2 Motor Service
services.notes: V2 ONLY. Fixed characteristic values; never write V3 type-length frames here.

v3_close.description: Calibrated V3 close: set closed percentage to 100 with 08 01 64.

v3_get_battery.description: V3 get battery percent 0b 00; read the matching 0b response.

v3_get_position.description: V3 get closed percentage 0a 00; read the matching 0a response from the response characteristic.

v3_open.description: Calibrated V3 open: set closed percentage to 0 with 08 01 00.

v3_raw_jog_close.advanced_reason: An uncalibrated motor has no end stops. Use only for a deliberately supervised, time-bounded calibration jog, never as ordinary close.
v3_raw_jog_close.description: Raw close-direction uncalibrated jog 02 00, only while travel limits are explicitly known to be unconfigured; a calibrated shade ignores it. The client must bound the jog and send v3_stop.

v3_raw_jog_open.advanced_reason: An uncalibrated motor has no end stops. Use only for a deliberately supervised, time-bounded calibration jog, never as ordinary open.
v3_raw_jog_open.description: Raw open-direction uncalibrated jog 01 00, only while travel limits are explicitly known to be unconfigured; a calibrated shade ignores it. The client must bound the jog and send v3_stop.

v3_set_position.description: V3 set closed percentage: opcode 08, length 1, one data byte 0-100.

characteristics.name: V3 Command Response
characteristics.notes: Plain GATT read after a command write; no notification behavior is assumed. Parse type | length | data, require the requested opcode and reject a truncated payload. A response for another opcode may be stale and is not success.

services.name: SOMA V3 Control Service
services.notes: V3 ONLY, discovered after connection and not reliably advertised. Every request is type(1) | length(1) | data(length).
